LOC = physical lines (loc_total) and non-blank, non-comment lines (loc_code), counted by a scratch script (not committed). Dependencies by AST import analysis plus path string references to repository .py files; external = non-stdlib, non-repository top-level imports. Mechanical results; each parity contract must re-verify them.
